sourceOfTruth: GOVERNANCE DOCUMENTS/PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE AND WORKFLOW SPECIFICATION.md, Part Nine, and OPERATIONAL MANUALS/PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE AND BUILD ROADMAP.md, Part 5 — this manifest is a status board over that governance, never the other way around
updateInstructions: Edit only the "status" (and optionally "note") field on a task when real work happens. Valid statuses: not-started, in-progress, complete, blocked. Do not add, remove, or reorder tasks without checking them against the governing documents first. The server re-reads this file on every request, so a saved edit shows up the next time the dashboard polls, no restart needed.
